A '''wooden axe''' is an [[Tools#Axe|axe]] of the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] tier, crafted from three planks and two sticks. It is the first woodcutting tool and, at {{Hp|7}} per hit, the hardest-hitting wooden weapon.

== Usage ==

=== Woodcutting ===
It keeps the vanilla wooden axe's mining speed of {{Value|Wooden Axe|miningspeed}}, but its durability is raised from 59 to {{Value|Wooden Axe|durability}}. Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Wooden Axe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Wooden Axe|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with planks. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
